# Certified Excellent Roofing Services

Get a roof that you can trust to stand up against the elements. Established in 1993, Pinnacle Roofing & Sheet Metal, Inc. will build you a commercial roof that you know will serve your commercial building well.

From maintenance to large-scale repairs, our experienced team will be on the job to restore functionality to your roof.

![Commercial](https://le-cdn.hibuwebsites.com/983869aca4494363a1e28ddf9dfabe34/dms3rep/multi/opt/12406286_230x150-1920w.jpg)

### Roof repairs and installations

- Flat roofing installation, maintenance, and repair
- Waterproofing
- Top-quality installations
- Energy Star White Roofing Systems
- Energy efficient roof insulation
- Re-roofing

![Commercial](https://le-cdn.hibuwebsites.com/983869aca4494363a1e28ddf9dfabe34/dms3rep/multi/opt/12406285_230x150-1920w.jpg)

### Roof maintenance and inspections

- New construction and replacement
- Preventative maintenance
- Roof system maintenance and repair
- Extended warranty service coverage
- Roof inspections
- On-call service technicians

We have two locations, Nanticoke & Dickson City , to better serve you.

![Commercial](https://le-cdn.hibuwebsites.com/983869aca4494363a1e28ddf9dfabe34/dms3rep/multi/opt/12406284_240x150-1920w.png)
